idea_brief_text: We keep hearing from Finance that expense reimbursement takes too long. An employee submits a paper or emailed expense claim, it goes through 2-3 manager approvals, and Finance has to manually re-key everything into the accounting system. Employees don't know where their claim is stuck, and Finance spends hours a week just chasing approvers. We think a small internal tool where employees submit claims digitally, approvers get a single dashboard, and Finance gets a clean export, would fix most of this.
